faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and French.

items.q: Does it handle French accents correctly?
items.a: Yes, letters like é, è, ê, ç, and à appear correctly in both the written translation and what gets spoken aloud.

items.q: Can it translate spoken French back to English?
items.a: Yes — speak French into the mic and get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Does it use vous or tu appropriately?
items.a: Yes, it aims to match the formality of your sentence rather than defaulting to one form.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need a French keyboard for accents?
items.a: No, the app handles accented letters automatically — no special keyboard needed.

items.q: Can I hear how the French translation is pronounced?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon on any translation to hear it read aloud.
